this_title: Michel Foucault: Beyond Good and Evil
trans_title: 米歇爾·福柯 超越善與惡
introduction: Michel Foucault: Beyond Good and Evil, explores the philosopher and his complex and controversial life through interviews with colleagues and biographers and re-enactments of Foucault’s storied exploits in the American counterculture.
